items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
items.claim: The text says the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron and gave them the instruction that follows.

items.quote: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
items.claim: Moses and Aaron are told to count the Kohathites, a group within the Levites, by family and by their fathers' houses.
items.object: the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi
items.mechanism: census by families and by the house of their fathers

items.quote: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
items.claim: The count covers Kohathite men from 30 to 50 years old who join the service to work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
items.action: enter into the host, to do the work
items.object: the work in the tabernacle of the congregation
items.mechanism: age limit for service (thirty to fifty years old)
